Hmm dp_y[p] means p is Y; children must be X? If child is Y... p is Y, child leaf with Y—dp_x[q][i] where i counts leaf Y count; child dp_x requires child be X. Actually child being Y also fine? Both child Y and parent Y: allowed since c non-leaf Y count. dp_y of child should count too. So line 34 should also consider dp_y children. But primary: -1+1 corruption. Rank line 34 high, line 42 moderate.
